svg.title: PGlite or SQLite-vec
svg.desc: Choosing the engine starts with the data model. If search results must join relational metadata, filter on JSONB, combine with BM25 full-text search, or sync with a backend Postgres, choose PGlite, a full Postgres runtime in WebAssembly with pgvector's HNSW index. Otherwise, for a bounded corpus such as a local documentation assistant, SQLite-vec's extension with brute-force KNN search keeps deployment simpler.
